title: File:112-6 Galitzine (52544957845).jpg
art: Russian Orthodox Cathedral of St John the Baptist, Washington DC from Washington DC, United States
desc:
Grave 112-6: Prince Nicholas Vasilievitch Galitzine (1899-1980).  Son of Prince Vassily Dimitrievich Galitzine (1857-1926) and Countess Prascovia Mikhailovna Tolstoi (1858-1918).
Married, first, Lydia Alexandrovna de Miller, 24 Aug 1922 in Paris, France (divorced). Lydia later married Ivan Mikhailov

desc: Section: V, Lot: 127, Grave: 5 - Dorothy Galitzine (15 Nov 1899 Saint Petersburg, Russia - 24 Aug 1962 Washington DC, USA) / Born Dorothée Belaiev. Second wife of Prince Nicholas Galatzine (1899-1980). They married in Geneva on 27 Mar 1950 (civil) and in Florence on 17 Apr 1950 (religious).
